title: Mammography: a third set of masses and calcifications on CC and MLO views
description: Screen-film mammograms (CBIS-DDSM, digitised film): the CC and MLO views of one breast of each woman, with a single abnormality outlined on both views. Spiculated malignant and circumscribed benign masses (the mass outline), and calcifications from fine pleomorphic and fine linear branching (malignant) to lucent-centered and coarse (benign; the region outline), with BI-RADS assessment and pathology as the dataset gives them. Chosen by the round-4 rule (subtlety 4-5, the same descriptors on both views) among women not used before.
